articles.title: BNY 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BNY 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. As previously announced, The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation ("BNY") (NYSE: BK), a global financial services company, will hold the 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders on Tuesday, April 14, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. ET. The Notice of Annual Meeting and Proxy Statement was made available on March 5, 2026. Related tickers mentioned: BK-PK.
